entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You sure it's not just physical abuse?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you talkin' all polite for?[n]Anyways...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We saw him spike you today.[n]Right in the face.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: That was just because I'm not good at[n]the sport...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Still, that doesn't explain all the other[n]bruises you've got.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Is he forcin' you to keep quiet?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Mishima, isn't it time for practice?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: What? Maybe you're better off quitting[n]then.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: You're never going to improve that[n]crappy form unless you show up to[n]practice.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Didn't you hear? He ain't feelin' well!

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Well, Mishima? Are you coming to[n]practice or not?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: As for you, any more trouble and you'll be[n]gone from this school for sure.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Didn't the principal tell you to keep[n]in line?

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Hmph. Just don't get in the way of my[n]practice.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: All these unsettling rumors are making[n]the students anxious, after all.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Shujin Academy is a place where those[n]with aspirations come to learn.

entries.speaker: Kamoshida
entries.en: Unworthy students like yourselves don't[n]have any right to be here.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Proving that he's physically abusing us...[n]is meaningless.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Everybody knows... The principal,[n]our parents... They all know, and[n]they all keep quiet about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: This has gotta be a joke...

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: ...Don't be a pain. You don't understand[n]what I'm going through.

entries.speaker: Mishima
entries.en: Shouldn't you of all people know that[n]nothing's going to help!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...I'll try one more time to persuade the[n]other guys. That's... all I can do.
